methodologyNotes: Covers residential electric (AC-powered) primary sump pumps sold at a published US price for basement and crawl-space water removal, both submersible and pedestal designs. Excludes battery/DC backup pumps, water-powered backup pumps, utility/transfer pumps, sewage and grinder pumps, and effluent/septic pumps. Price is typical US MSRP or street price in USD. horsepowerHp is rated motor power in horsepower as published (fractional values allowed). maxFlowGph is the manufacturer's rated maximum flow at zero lift in US gallons per hour. maxHeadFt is the maximum total head / shutoff lift in feet. pumpType is an enum: submersible or pedestal. switchType is an enum for the automatic switch: vertical-float, tethered-float, diaphragm, electronic, or dual-float; use manual for pumps sold without a switch. dischargeSizeIn is the discharge port NPT size in inches. solidsHandlingIn is the maximum spherical solids the impeller passes, in inches; 0 if the pump is not rated to pass solids. housingMaterial is the primary motor/volute housing material enum: cast-iron, thermoplastic, stainless-steel, zinc, aluminum, or epoxy-coated-cast-iron. voltageV is the AC supply voltage in volts. cordLengthFt is the power cord length in feet. warrantyYears is the limited warranty length in years. Any spec not published by the manufacturer is null.

products.provenance: The archived Zoeller manufacturer product page (Product SKU 53-0001, UPC 053514023607, "Mighty-Mate M53" LED-Plug 9' cord) confirms this exact model and lists its Product Specifications verbatim: Horsepower 0.30 (3/10 HP), Voltage 115, 1-1/2" NPT discharge, 1/2" (12 mm) solids handling, switch case/motor housing/pump housing each constructed of cast iron, Cord Length 9' (3 m), and a 3-year limited warranty; it is described as a fully automatic float-operated submersible sump pump. The SepticSolutions retailer page corroborates the identical model (Model M53, Part No. 53-0001) and supplies the shutoff head ("Shut Off: 19.25ft"), 43 Max GPM, the "Integral Vertical Float Switch", and the price ("$229.00 MSRP: $295.00"). Maximum flow is published only in GPM (43), never in gallons-per-hour, so maxFlowGph is left null rather than derived.
